title: Sum formulas
text: The sum of i from $$1$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n\left(n+1\right)}{2}$$, and the sum of $$i^2$$ from $$1$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n\left(n+1\right) \left(2n+1\right)}{6}$$.

title: Evaluate each piece
text: With $$n=20$$: the sum of $$k^2$$ is $$2870$$, the sum of k is $$210$$, and the sum of $$1$$ is $$20$$. So the sum is $$100\left(2870-5\times210+20\right)=100\times1840=184000$$.
